name: "I'd Rather Lose Money Myself..." (In Effect)
description:
Each time your opponent gains 1 Elemental Die during this Round: If you have not declared the end of your Round, you will create 1 Omni Element. Otherwise, create 1 Shield.
Usage(s): 3
